arcTitle: Arc V · The Plague of the Hollow Reaches
narrative:
At a Hollow Reaches roadside inn, Elder Pella coughs once into a handkerchief and apologizes for the noise. Her grandson keeps pouring tea as though politeness can hold the room together. Old Hendrik sits near the stove, quieter than you remember.

@Hendrik: Weather gets into old beams. And old lungs. Don't look at me like that.

narrative:
Bettina unlocks the medicine chest exactly once. There is enough for one household. Hendrik's room is at one end of the lane; a family of strangers burns with fever at the other. A merchant offers more gold than the whole village has seen this year.

@Bettina: Procedure has no answer for this. It only says I must write down what you decide.

narrative: The cordon holds, barely. Yssa sleeps sitting upright for the first time in weeks. If Hendrik lives, he complains that everyone has become too gentle with him; if he does not, his empty chair remains near the stove. The village learns the names of the dead before it learns to laugh again.

effects.run_history: Saw the Hollow Reaches plague contained

narrative: The cordon breaks where hunger always breaks it: at a family door. Carts leave for the Capital before the fever has finished choosing them. Bettina records each departure and then tears the page from her ledger.

narrative:
You stay long enough for the light in the clinic window to change color. Yssa doesn't ask you to leave, and doesn't fill the silence either - she's buried enough people this season to know some visits aren't for the living patients still waiting.

Hendrik's coat still smells faintly of woodsmoke and whetstone oil. It's a smaller grief than the ones the whole village will carry, and somehow that makes it harder to share, not easier - a private weight nobody else in the room is positioned to help you carry.

choices.label: Take the toolkit, and carry the quiet with you

effects.run_history: Sat with Old Hendrik's belongings before carrying his tools onward

narrative:
You take the small chest without opening it fully - there will be time later, or there won't, and either way the road doesn't stop for either answer. Yssa presses his note into your hand as you pass, since you clearly won't be staying long enough for her to insist on it properly.

Grief, you've found, keeps better once you stop trying to feel the correct amount of it on schedule.

choices.label: Keep moving

effects.run_history: Left the Hollow clinic quickly, tools in hand, grief unspoken

narrative:
The note is three lines, unsigned except for a single initial. It says the valley is well. It says the coop is holding. It does not ask how you are, and does not offer to tell you how she is either.

But it found you. Someone would have had to ask, carefully, which road you'd taken, and to whom, for a note like this to arrive at all.

narrative: A royal carriage passes the Hollow road under black curtains. The King is ill, the driver says, and the Capital has begun to count heirs aloud. The plague has reached farther than any cart, even where no fever followed.
